title: skills: project-setup.md's CLI table still lists `objectui studio`, `lint`, `test` and `create plugin`, retired by objectui#11500
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a shipped-surface sentence that is wrong after a landing, with a named location. The second card in objectui#11503's family.

`reach:` a named real producer. `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` belongs to the shipped `objectui` skill, which agents setting up an objectui project read. Its CLI table teaches four commands that PR objectui#11508 (objectui#11500, triage ruling `5960445419`) retired; it landed as `37268aae9`. The built CLI now refuses each as an unknown command, exits 1 and writes nothing, pinned in `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts`. Rows at objectui `main` `37268aae9`:
- `:168` `| \`objectui studio\` | Visual UI editor |`
- `:171` `| \`objectui lint\` | Lint generated app code (ESLint) |`
- `:172` `| \`objectui test\` | Run app tests (Vitest) |`
- `:174` `| \`objectui create plugin\` | Scaffold a new plugin |`

An agent following the guide runs a command the CLI refuses. For `create plugin`, the working path is the package's own initializer, `npm create @object-ui/plugin NAME`, as `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx` now says. For `lint` / `test`, it is the project's own ESLint / Vitest. `studio` has no published replacement.

## Why a card, not a re-grep
Triage's note on objectui#11503 (`5960472347`) said the `skills` seat would grep `skills/objectui/**` again once objectui#11500 landed, without waiting for another card. But objectui#11503 closed with PR objectui#11507, which carried only `add` / `analyze`, before objectui#11500 landed. And the `skills` seat post objectui#11311 reads vacant. With no seat to do the re-grep, the card is the carrier. PR objectui#11508's Acceptance notes name the same four rows with `carrier: seat → objectui#11503`, and objectui#11503 is now closed.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
Drop the four rows, as PR objectui#11507 dropped `add`. Optionally, one line in the table's prose names `npm create @object-ui/plugin` for scaffolding a plugin package. The file is governed (`skills/**`), so it lands by human approval, as PR objectui#11507 did. A grep of `skills/objectui/**` for the four command names belongs in the same PR.

Reader who acts: triage first (grade), then `domain:skills`. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Dedupe
- REST issue search on objectui (`"project-setup" studio lint`, `is:open "objectui studio"`): 11 and 6 hits. None is an open card about these rows. The nearest are objectui#11503 and PR objectui#11507 (closed, `add` / `analyze` only) and objectui#11500 (closed, the retirement itself).
- REST scan of the 900 most recently created objectui issues and PRs, open and closed: `project-setup` gives 4 hits, all closed, none about these four rows (objectui#11507, #11503, #11316, #11011). `objectui studio` / `objectui lint` / `objectui test` in titles gives 0 hits. The control term `project-setup` does return hits, so the corpus answers.
